title: console-observability-triage-scratchpad-priya-2026-03-05
content:
Daily triage notes (personal scratchpad) - focus: dashboard bugs / customer-reported issues / follow-ups

Date: 2026-03-05
Owner: Priya Iyer
Context: quick personal log from on-call triage session. Mostly rough notes + action items to transfer into JIRA or handoff.

1) Customer: Acme Corp - cost-analytics dashboard spike
- Reported: 2026-03-04 14:45 UTC via account CS thread (ticket RINF-3210). Customer saw sudden spike in per-request token-cost metric for last 24h.
- Observed: token-cost widget shows persistent high values starting ~2026-03-04 14:30 UTC. Related metrics: cache_miss_rate up ~6x, batching_latency up ~40ms p50.
- Quick repro: run the query they linked (query id: acme-cost-query-20260304). I was able to reproduce in prod region us-west-2 on route 'api-serve-v2' with a synthetic run.
- Temp workaround: restarted route-edge-1 (briefly reduced spike), cleared prefix cache for that customer (manual), alerted CS.
- Likely root cause hypotheses: a) KV/prefix cache eviction policy regression after rollout PR #456 (see GitHub link), b) batching heuristic change -> smaller batches causing higher per-token compute, c) bad config for customer-specific caching TTL.
- Artifacts: logs attached in JIRA RINF-3210, traces saved to APM (trace ids: trace:20260304-owen-01).
- Next steps (priority):
  - Collect full traces for 14:30-15:30 window and correlate with cache eviction logs (ASSIGNED: Owen Park, due 2026-03-06)
  - Add temporary alert for cache_miss_rate > 3% for customer-scoped metrics (ASSIGNED: Emily Nguyen, due 2026-03-05 EOD)
  - Roll back PR #456 in staging and run perf test to compare cache miss curves (me + Chris, target 2026-03-06)
  - Confirm whether dedicated-customer TTL override was applied accidentally (ask infra config owner)

2) Dashboard rendering bug: cost breakdown bucket order inconsistent
- Symptom: In the cost breakdown table, buckets occasionally render in alpha order instead of cost-descending. Reported by internal QE while validating fix.
- Repro steps: open dashboard -> filter by date 2026-02-28..2026-03-04 -> expand cost-breakdown -> observe order flip. Happens intermittently (~1/10 page loads).
- Hypothesis: client-side sort fallback when server returns empty sort key; race between streaming updates and final payload. Possibly introduced when we added streaming partial updates in hosted-api change.
- Quick test: disable streaming in local UI and reload -> ordering stable.
- Action: create small repro harness and write unit test for ordering logic (ASSIGNED: Priya, todo). File a small PR to ensure stable sort key present server-side.

3) Follow-ups for console ops and instrumentation
- Add APM span tag 'customer_id' to model-serving spans to make correlation with per-customer dashboards easier (proposal discussed with SRE). Create ticket and estimate scope.
- Add dashboard panel showing batch-size distribution p50/p90 over last 7d. This will help detect small-batch regression. (ASSIGNED: Chris Patel, backlog)
- Verify that rollout service adds a rollout-id header on requests (useful to correlate buggy windows). If missing, add to rollout tracing docs.

4) Notes to self (small TODOs)
- Move the Acme troubleshooting notes into RINF-3210 and attach the trace link.
- Draft customer-facing summary for CS (2-3 bullet explanation + mitigation steps) - keep it high level, no internal conf details.
- Remind infra team to check scheduled job that rebuilds cache indexes at midnight (could coincide with spikes).

5) Meeting / handover
- Quick sync with Owen + Emily tomorrow 09:30 PT to review traces and decide whether to pin cache TTL for Acme. (Calendar invite pending)
- If we confirm rollout PR #456 is the cause, plan a staged rollback and notify affected customers via CS.

Misc. links / refs:
- GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/456
- JIRA issue: RINF-3210 (customer: Acme Corp)
- Slack thread: #observability -> thread ts:1688123456.000200
- Confluence: dashboards-cache-behavior (notes + previous incidents)

End of scratchpad. Will convert action items to JIRA and update status once done.
